      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "assert_true and assert_false checked truthiness instead of strict boolean True and False",
      "quote": "they're not actually asserting `True`, but rather truthiness",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author pushed a fix using 'is not'",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4019760435"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4019760435",
      "status_by_quote": "Thanks for catching the accidental degradation in correctness! I originally used != True/!= False but the ruff linter re"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4019082601",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "add unit tests for assert_true and assert_false",
      "quote": "I would also like to see tests added to explain their behavior",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that util methods lack meta-tests and asked where to add them",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4019760435"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4019760435",
      "status_by_quote": "None of the other util methods have these meta-tests AFAIK. If you insist do you have any suggestion for where to start "
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6913067667",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "usefulness",
      "text": "explain why this change is worth having when more useful changes like #34395 were not accepted",
      "quote": "However, https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34395 seems more useful than this and it didn't make it either.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author argued usefulness is subjective and added a scripted-diff guard commit inspired by that PR",
      "author_replies": ["c:6913948168"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6913948168",
      "status_by_quote": "Agree both are very low-priority, but it seems quite subjective which one is more useful"
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "notes": "Added maflcko's suggestion questioning the usefulness of the change compared to #34395, which the author answered.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
